name: off-guidance-follows-model-change
description: official-host.ts:340 'context guidance follows model/settings changes during continuation and reset (forced=False)'. The model calls a helper tool that switches to a larger model (settings carry a per-model reserve override for it, standing in for the test's applyOverrides of the reserve), then calls new_context; the system guidance of the continuation and of the fresh window must state the new capacity (272,000) and rollover line (208,001) and only once. The small model's first request states 100,000 / 83,617.
